sqlquery.from: ( select max(s.name) statusName, max(p.name) priorityName ,sum(case s.code when 'NEW' then 1 else 0 end) newCount ,sum(case s.code when 'REOPENED' then 1 else 0 end) reopenedCount ,sum(case s.code when 'CS_CLOSED' then 1 else 0 end) closedCount ,sum(case s.code when 'WAITING_FOR_REPLY' then 1 else 0 end) waitingCount ,sum(case s.code when 'ESCALATED' then 1 else 0 end) escalatedCount ,sum(case s.code when 'CS_ON_HOLD' then 1 else 0 end) onHoldCount from "$".crmcase c join "$".reference s on c.status=s.id join "$".reference p on c.priority=p.id where s.code in ('NEW','REOPENED','CS_CLOSED','WAITING_FOR_REPLY','ESCALATED','CS_ON_HOLD') and c.deleted is not true group by p.code, s.code ) t
